row: Arctic Fox Daily Wildlife Rescue, Inc.

I'm Kim, President and Founder of Arctic Fox Daily. At our unique, home-based sanctuary, we provide a forever home to unwanted, neglected, abandoned, or confiscated captive-bred and non-releasable wildlife, specializing in foxes and wolfdogs.

I also volunteer my time raising orphaned and/or injured New York-native wildlife, with the ultimate goal being release back into nature - where they belong.

I rescued wildlife as a licensed individual for over a decade, and then officially founded Arctic Fox Daily Wildlife Rescue, Inc. in 2020, a 501(c)(3) nonprofit organization. We rely fully on contributions from our amazing supporters. The more support we receive, the more animals we can help. Follow @arcticfoxdaily on our other platforms, and visit www.arcticfoxdaily.org to learn more or to see the different ways you can show support.

I'm making my childhood dreams of rescue come true, while raising two babies of my own, Ella and Clay. Thanks for tagging along on our rescue journey!
